描述_EN: after 1300, chinese potters at jingdezhen began to decorate the local white porcelain in cobalt blue. but large dishes such as this one were made for export back to the middle east, where the cobalt for the blue had come from. smaller items have chinese shapes and may have been made for the home market. they perfected the painting technique, so that the blue did not run during firing.
描述_ZN: 1300年后，中国景德镇的陶工开始用钴蓝装饰当地的白瓷。 但像这样的大盘子是为出口到中东而制作的，因为那里的蓝色钴是来自中东。 较小的物品具有中国的形状，可能是为家庭市场制作的。 他们完善了绘画技术，使蓝色在烧制过程中不会流淌。
